CommunityApplications.Profile: Unofficial Unraid template and Docker image for Orca (onorca.dev), Stably's open-source app for running coding agents in parallel git worktrees. The image runs orca serve headless and is rebuilt for every Orca release. Not affiliated with Stably: report problems with the container on this repository's GitHub issues, and problems with Orca itself at github.com/stablyai/orca.
